# Euro 2024: Croatia star Luka Modric becomes oldest goalscorer at a European Championship
Updated Jun. 24, 2024 5:20 p.m. ET
share

[Croatia](https://www.foxsports.com/soccer/croatia-men-team) veteran [Luka Modric](https://www.foxsports.com/soccer/luka-modric-pl", "has_earlier_text": true, "has_later_text": true, "evidence_id": "E2"}, {"offset": 2520, "read_offset": 2320, "section": {"heading": "Euro 2024: Croatia star Luka Modric becomes oldest goalscorer at a European Championship", "offset": 2040}, "matched_terms": ["luka", "modric", "team"], "window_matched_terms": ["luka", "modric", "team"], "missing_excerpt_terms": ["2008-2012"], "excerpt_offset": 2320, "excerpt_end": 3320, "excerpt": "player) scored against [Italy](https://www.foxsports.com/soccer/italy-men-team) to become the oldest goalscorer ever at a [European Championship](https://www.foxsports.com/soccer/2024-uefa-euro-cup).
Modric, who is 38 years, 289 days old, claimed the opening goal on a rebound in the 55th minute, within a minute of having a penalty saved by Italy goalkeeper [Gianluigi Donnarumma](https://www.foxsports.com/soccer/gianluigi-donnarumma-player). The Croatia captain was mobbed by his teammates as he fell on his back on the pitch in celebration.
### Luka Modric becomes oldest goalscorer at Euros, gives Croatia 1-0 lead vs. Italy
[ ![Luka Modric becomes oldest goalscorer at Euros, gives Croatia 1-0 lead vs. Italy](https://a57.foxsports.com/static-media.fox.com/fmc/prod/sports/VX-9463140/1600/900/o9lwjr00jet6y88j.jpg?ve=1&tl=1)](https://www.foxsports.com/watch/fmc-6me5h37fo5qas155)
The previous record weas held by Ivica Vastic, who was 38 years, 257 days old when he scored for [Austria](https:/", "has_earlier_text": true, "has_later_text": true, "evidence_id": "E3"}, {"offset": 3773, "read_offset": 3573, "section": {"heading": "Luka Modric becomes oldest goalscorer at Euros, gives Croatia 1-0 lead vs. Italy", "offset": 2865}, "matched_terms": ["modric", "team"], "window_matched_terms": ["luka", "modric", "team"], "missing_excerpt_terms": ["luka", "2008-2012"], "excerpt_offset": 3573, "excerpt_end": 4573, "excerpt": "soccer/portugal-men-team) striker and captain [Cristiano Ronaldo](https://www.foxsports.com/soccer/cristiano-ronaldo-player), can break his record as he is 39 years and 135 days old.
It may have been Modric's last defining major-tournament moment for Croatia in his storied career. Croatia now faces an uphill battle to go through to the knockout stage of Euro 2024 after drawing 1-1 against Italy thanks to a dramatic 98th-minute goal at the end of stoppage time by [Mattia Zaccagni](https://www.foxsports.com/soccer/mattia-zaccagni-player).
